answer: Cosignatures are collected in relic, verified in anchor, and mirror names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 42 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 4 hours of verification and 9 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
